title: Mike Macdonald: Seahawks’ ‘Established starters’ won’t play vs. Cowboys

sources.title: Mike Macdonald: Seahawks’ ‘Established starters’ won’t play vs. Cowboys
sources.description: Don’t expect Sam Darnold, Jaxon Smith-Njigba, and other starters to do anything but warm-ups on Saturday night against the Cowboys.
